title: Adventurers in Windblume
description: Iris, who has set up shop at the Dragonspine base camp, seems to want some help...

dialogs.text: So, about your commission...
Saw my commission and came running, did you? Well, I do have something that I need your help with.
Specifically, I'd like you to take pictures of two places on Dragonspine. I'll mark the exact locations for you on your map.
As for compensation, I'll make sure you're paid as per the Adventurers' Guild's rules.
How about it? Will you take the commission?
Why do you need to take pictures in these two spots?
Well... this has to do with Cyrus, ultimately.
He asked me previously to get him some of Dragonspine's specialties. Said he wanted to use them as part of a recruitment drive during the Windblume Festival.
Well, now's the festival period, but he hasn't contacted me at all. Must be busy, I suppose...
Now that I mention it, he is at that age, isn't he? He should be busy with the festival.
I think he might be way too old for that by now...
Really? I don't really get that feeling. In fact... Hmm, never mind. Let's not get into that right now.
So far, I've collected some ores and put together some topographical charts and monster reports. I'd like some photos of scenic spots in Dragonspine to go with them.
So, Traveler, would you mind helping me go up Dragonspine to take pictures of those two spots?
You can count on me.
Great, I'll leave it in your hands, then. I've marked the two places out on your map. Just head there and come back once you're done.
Not going to the city to see how things are going?
It's all a little too much for me. I personally prefer how things are here.
I've got quite a lot on my plate to boot, so I doubt I can go at the moment.
I've marked the most scenic spots on your map. Just head there and come back once you're done.

dialogs.text: About the commission...
I've marked the most scenic spots on your map. Just head there and come back once you're done.
So, about your commission...
Oh, you're done already?
Sure am.

Thanks for your hard work. I've got the package I intended to send to that boy ready as well. Would you mind delivering it to him? I'll have your payment ready once you're done, so do remember to come back here.
I'm not sure if this will be enough for him to use, but if he's recruiting, monster records and ores should pack the biggest punch...
*sigh* This recruitment drive doesn't look like it'll be any good at all...
Special delivery from Iris...
Oh, she sent me something? Right, that's right. I did ask her before, but I wound up forgetting...
What happened to enjoying the Windblume Festival?
The Windblume Festival? No, I haven't any time for that. Our previous recruitment program is obsolete, I'm busy coming up with a new one...
Let me see what Iris sent me...
Ores... No, that's no use... Young people these days couldn't be bothered with this stuff...
Maps? *sigh* Oh, it'll be useful to the Guild members, alright, but I don't think that it's any good for recruitment...
Notes concerning monsters? Well, we should make some extra copies for our adventurers, but forget using it to attract new people...
Oho, what's this? These two photos are pretty good. Beautiful scenery — and it looks safe, too. Ah, this'll catch someone's eye, that's for sure!
Why're you picking this?
Looks like he's thrown out the ones actually related to adventuring...
Ah, you don't understand the state the Guild's in. Nowadays, young people aren't interested in things like monsters, ores and topographical maps anymore.
If you want to get the modern youngster's attention, you need to give them something they can use.
It's the Windblume Festival now, see, and these young folks are definitely spoiling for all sorts of unique — but not necessarily dangerous — ways of displaying their charm...
Adventuring in Dragonspine is one such thing they can do. If the photos interest them, they might come to the Guild to ask about them, and then, they might join the Guild...
And... even if they don't join, well... some extra commissions would be nice.
What's more, if you look at these two drawings, they are both positioned next to the main road. As long as you're careful, you shouldn't be in any danger...
We're really scraping the bottom of the barrel, aren't we...
Well, this is how things are. I wouldn't do this if we had any other ideas we could use.
If you don't believe me, why don't you take these two photos and show them to some people?
First, tell them that we're recruiting, and then show these two photos as "recruitment material."
You'll see why I had to come up with this idea in no time at all.

flow.stepDescription: Head to the Anemo Archon statue

dialogs.text: Take these two pictures and ask some people nearby. Then you'll see why I had to come up with this idea in the first place...

flow.stepDescription: Speak to the citizens around the Anemo Archon statue

dialogs.text: #Hey there, {M#amigo}{F#amiga}! Would you like to hear my latest composition?
About the Adventurers' Guild recruitment...
Adventurers' Guild recruitment? Lo siento, I'm not interested in such things. Running around like a headless chicken is of no use to a bard.
Besides, in the city of Mondstadt, surely the Knights of Favonius constitute better source material for composing an epic...
Lo siento, I'm not interested in the Adventurers' Guild recruitment. Rescuing cats... isn't great song-writing material.
Here's the recruitment material.
Is this... Dragonspine? Qué vista magnífica...
Perhaps a spot of sight-seeing would give me new flourishes of inspiration. And it doesn't look too dangerous...
Hmm... I'll pass by the Guild later and have a word. Even if I don't sign up, I'm sure I could hire an adventurer to escort me...
A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.
A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.

flow.stepDescription: Speak to the citizens around the Anemo Archon statue

dialogs.text: Oh! Can I help you? I was just about to start a tune.
About the Adventurers' Guild recruitment...
Oh, that... I did see a notice, but it doesn't interest me. I can protect Mondstadt with my song, I don't need to become an adventurer.
I heard that the majority of commissions are odd jobs. I don't see how it would benefit me.
Sorry, I will politely decline, but thank you for thinking of me.
Here's the recruitment material.
Huh? That looks like Dragonspine. A Statue of The Seven surrounded by snow... such a striking image.
So this must be at quite an altitude? People say that you can see for miles around up there... I bet my voice could carry over much further distances...
I'll go and ask at the Guild a little later. I'm sure I saw something about adventurers for hire...
I had no idea that adventurers went to such places... fascinating.
I must go and ask at the Adventurers' Guild later...
Take these two pictures and ask some people nearby. Then you'll see why I had to come up with this idea in the first place...
A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.
I must go and ask at the Adventurers' Guild later...
How did it go? Did you manage to gauge how everyone feels?
I did.
Then you see what I mean... That's the way things are. I've gotten used to it by now.
*sigh* I don't care how we do it... But so long as we find a method that brings results, I'll thank the Archons.
I guess you'll be heading back to Dragonspine soon to report in with Iris?
Do me a favor and deliver this letter to her. She'll definitely want to know about the situation of late here at the Guild. Thank you!
*sigh* I hope we get some new recruits this time... But will the type of person who responds to this kind of marketing tactic be reliable adventurer material...?
A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.
I must go and ask at the Adventurers' Guild later...
About the commission...
You're back! What took you so long? I bet Cyrus got you to run some extra errands...
I helped him make a few inquiries...
Just what is that boy up to now... Oh? A letter?
This letter talks about the recent state of the Guild.
Huh, doesn't feel like a short read. Seems like he has been busy after all, even during the Windblume Festival...
Still, if he is working so hard, it's about time the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild recruited some new members.
Once we have enough recruits, he should be able to delegate the smaller matters to others and come adventuring with me again... *sigh* That would be nice.
I'll give this a good read. But seeing as Cyrus added to your workload, it's only fair that I factor in some extra payment.
Here you go. Thanks for your hard work!
A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.
I must go and ask at the Adventurers' Guild later...
*sigh* I hope we get some new recruits this time... But will the type of person who responds to this kind of marketing tactic be reliable adventurer material...?
